tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ bka' 'khor lo bar pa'i yang bcud shes rab snying po'i mdo la brten pa'i bdud zlog bar chad kun sel lag len lta chog tu bkod pa rnam thar stobs skyed ces bya ba bzhugs so//

spros pa'i mtha' bral smra bsam brjod las 'das// rgyal ba'i yum gyur de la gus btud nas// gsung rab yang bcud shes rab snying po yi// bdud zlog lag len bltas pas chog pa bri// 'phags yul nas 'gyur ba'i gto dkar bzhi zhes grags pa/ khung dang ldan cing byin rlabs nus mthu rmad du byung ba'i ya gyal sher snying bdud zlog 'di la spyi don gnyis// lo rgyus dang*/ gzhung gi nyams len no// dang po ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ spyan ras gzigs/ thugs rje chen po blo gros rin chen/ gser gling pa/ jo bo a ti shā/ dge bshes ston pa/ pu to ba rin chen gsal/ ring mo 'byung gnas rdo rje/ gyi ljang dbu dkar ba/ mchims chen nam mkha' grags pa/ 'khon ku mar bud+dha nas rim bzhin brgyud pa'i zam ma chad par byung ba'i gdams ngag ste/ yid ches pa'i lo rgyus kyang*/ gyi ljang dbu dkar bas 'di nyid yi dam mdzad cing yid ches par yod pa las/ yul der gyi ljang ku lo zhes bya ba yod pa des gshin rje dmar nag dang mon pa dmar nag la sogs pa mngon du rgyug gtub par mkhyen pas khong gis mi mang po mthus bsgral ba las/ nyin gcig gyi ljang dbu dkar bas ku lo la zhal skyems drangs/ go ba bskon/ bslab bya byas nas khyod kyis mthu myur po dgongs kyang phyi ma rnam smin shin tu lci ba yod tshul sogs zhus pas/ khong gi mtshangs la phog nas khros te khyod zhag bdun phan chad du mi bzhag zer mna' bskyal te ku lo khros nas song ba/ dbu dkar bas 'di nyid kyi sgrub pa mdzad pas/ zhag bdun nas kho rang gi mthu kho rang la ldog ste 'chi'o// des na byad zlog kyang khyad par du 'phags so// yang rgya nag pha co zhig la rgyal pos gnod pa la/ rtsis mkhan gyis rtsis byas pas/ bu chung gi ro la gto byas te ja sig gcig gi nang du bcug nas dbus su bskur na phan zer/ de ltar byas nas dbus su bskur/

'phan yul du dbus pa ge sar gyis nyos pa las/ rgyal pos ge sar la gnod nas rta drel bong gsum thams cad med par byas so// rgyal po dngos su mthong rgyu yod par 'dug pas/ ge sar gyis rgyal po la dris nas khyod su la 'jigs byas pas/ nga gyi ljang dbu dkar la 'jigs/ de bas su la mi 'jigs zer/ ge sar gyis rgyal po la smras pa/ gyi ljang dbu dkar ngas bsad pas chog /dbu dkar ba 'dug sa lam rgyus gyis shig byas nas kho bslus pas/ rgyal po des kyang lam rgyus byas nas dbu dkar ba'i rtsa ru phyin te/ ge sar gyi sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams zhus pas/ rgyal po bskrad pa'i man ngag 'di nyid sgrub thabs bcas gnang*/ ge sar gyis bdud zlog byas pas de phyin chad rgyal po'i gnod pa zhi zhing*/ blo chos su bkol thub pa byung ngo*// de nas rgyal po sngar bzhin rgya nag yul du log nas sngar gyi pha co'i rtsar song bas/ pha cos rgyal po khyod lo mang po'i bar gar phyin byas pas dbus su phyin pas dang po skyid po byung*/ phyis su sdug po rang byung zer/ su la 'jigs nas 'ong dris pas/ nga gyi ljang dbu dkar dang ge sar la 'jigs nas 'ong*/ da bar ge sar rtsa ru bsdad zer/ pha cos yang dbus su 'gro/ khyod kyi lam mkhan gyis/ ge sar gyi rtsa ru nged rang gnyis 'gro la 'dug byas te/ kho rang gi lam mkhan byas nas 'ong bas/ ge sar dang pha co 'phrad de sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams zhus shing 'bul ba bzang po phul nas/ rgyal po bskrad pa'i thabs kyi man ngag zhus pas 'di nyid gnang nas sgrub gsungs par/ pha cos sgrub pas de phyin chad rgyal po'i gnod pa ma byung ngo*// de sogs thun mong gi dngos grub gang 'dod 'byung zhing*/ khyad par du'ang mchog gi dngos grub 'grub par the tshom med do// gnyis pa nyams len dngos la gsum ste/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po sbyor ba ni/

gzhi dkar po'i steng du me tog sil ma bkram la/ dbus su stegs bu mtho ba'i steng du gdan bzang po la thub pa'i sku brnyan bris 'bur gang rung rab gnas ma nyams par zhal rang la bstan nas bzhugs su gsol ba'i mthar mtshams 'dzin me tog nas bzung ste nyer spyod lnga g.yas bskor du bshams/ de las dma' ba'i sar mdun ngos su lder snod lta bur yon bdag gi 'dra glud skye mched tshang zhing rgyan gyis brgyan pa gos dri can bskon la dar zab gser g.yu 'bru sna tshogs glud rdzas tshang bas bskor ba kha phar bsgyur te bzhag /de'i phyi rol du shar du zhal zas/ lhor gtor ma me tog gi dbyibs can/ nub tu dkar gtor/ byang du dmar gtor rnams theb rtse sogs su bshams/ de dag gi phyi rol du phyogs bzhi'i bdud dang 'dod yon rnams gru bzhir bcad de bzhag dgos pas/ de'ang shar ngos glud yod pa'i phyi rol du khal bdun/ de'i phyir khyi bdun/ de'i phyir changs bu bdun/ de'i phyir mtheb kyu bdun/ de'i phyir sha dum bdun/ de'i phyir zan chad bdun/ de'i phyir lha'i bu'i bdud mi rta dkar po g.yas me tog dang g.yon zhags pa bsnams pa bdun kha nang bstan du bkod/ des bsgre ste/ lho dang*/ nub dang*/ byang ngos la'ang nang nas phyi rim bzhin khal/ khyi/ changs bu/ mtheb kyu/ sha dum/ zan chad rnams bdun re dang*/ lhor nyon mongs pa'i bdud mi rta ser po g.yas ral gri dang g.yon zhags pa bsnams pa bdun/ nub tu phung po'i bdud mi rta dmar po g.yas mdung dang g.yon zhags pa bsnams pa bdun/ byang du 'chi bdag gi bdud mi rta nag po g.yas khram shing dang g.yon zhags pa bsnams pa bdun re kha nang bstan du bzhag /de'i g.yon nam mdun phyogs gang bder bdud zlog gi mar gzhi nag po ras byar lta bu bting*/ 'dzom na rkang gsum mam stegs bu zhig bzhag /gzhan yang chos srung gtor 'bul byed na rang lugs rgyas bsdus gang byed kyi gtor ma dang*/

rjes chog skabs mchod pa kha gso rgyu'i zhal zas/ rdzong 'debs 'bru dkar nag /sgo dbye 'i gser skyems dang dkar gtor/ sgrub pa po'i rol cha sogs 'tshogs par bya'o// 'don mkhan dge slong bzhi sde zhig yod na mchog yin la/ ma 'dzom na dge slong gcig gis kyang chog go /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed/ bdud zlog dngos so// dang po ni/ kha cig gis bdag bskyed yi dam gang mos la bya bar bshad pa dang*/ thub pa rdo rje gdan la byed pa dang*/ bdag bskyed gtan nas ma bshad pa sogs 'dug kyang*/ gang las byung ba'i khungs dang brgyud pa gong ma'i phyag len dang 'brel ba las bka' gdams lha bzhi'i thub pa'i bdag bskyed nyid legs pas de ltar na/ thog mar skyabs sems ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// sogs yan lag bdun pa'i tshigs bcad tshang bar brjod/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dam pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig /ces tshad med bzhi bsgoms la/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ ser po/ de'i 'od kyis lus gang*/ 'od kyi phung por gyur/ de las rang nyid thub pa'i dbang po'i skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sa gnon dang*/ g.yon mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can/ mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs shing*/ chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba/

'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro zhing thugs mnyam par bzhag pa'i bdag nyid can du gyur/ thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐/ de las 'od 'phros thub pa ye shes sems dpa'i lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ yid kyis phyag mchod bya/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar bsgoms la/ oṃ mu ne mu ne ma hā mu ne ye swā hā/ ci nus bzlas la/ mthar/ rang gi ye shes pa mdun du bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+da pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ ces 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /thub pa'i dbang po sogs kyis dge ba bsngo/ oṃ muḥ zhes brjod la gshegs so// rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal la gnas so// gnyis pa mdun bskyed thog mar mchod pa byin brlab pa ni/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho:sarba dharma swa bha wa shud+dho3 haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rāt+s+mum̐ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ zhes dang*/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ thog mtha' des 'gres te/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ nai wid+ya/ shap+da rnams sbyar/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ni ta/ pra ra ni ta/ saṃ pra ra ni ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa la ni/ pradz+nyā pa ra mi ta na da swa bhā we na/ badz+ra dharmā hri da ya/ san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā/

zhes lan gsum rol mo dang bcas pas byin dbab bo// de nas mdun bskyed kyi rten/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du oṃ mu ne mu ne ma hā mu ne ye swā hā las bstan pa'i bdag po yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dbu la gtsug tor dang zhabs la 'khor lo la sogs pa mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/ na bza' chos gos rnam pa gsum gsol zhing 'od dang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba'i 'khor du/ g.yas phyogs nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dkar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ 'jam dpal dbyangs gur gum gyi mdog can ral gri dang pusti 'dzin pa/ phyag na rdo rje sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ sa'i snying po ser po ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ sgrib pa rnam sel dkar po rin po che'i snye ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ byams pa ser po klu shing dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ kun tu bzang po sngon po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ nam mkha'i snying po sngon po ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis rang rang gi gdan la bzhugs pa/ g.yon phyogs nas 'phags pa shā ri'i bu/ mau gal gyi bu/ 'od srung*/ kun dga' bo/ nor sbyin 'dzin/ nye bar 'khor/ ma 'gag pa/ rab 'byor te thams cad kyang lhung bzed dang mkhar gsil 'dzin pa/ chos gos rnam gsum klubs shing pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga gdan la btsug pa'i tshul gyis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal la blta zhing bzhugs pa/

'khon gzhon nu sangs rgyas kyi gzhung du ston pa'i g.yas su spyan ras gzigs dang g.yon du shā ri'i bu gtso 'khor bkod pa 'di shes rab snying po'i gleng gzhi dang mthun no/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas ston pa shākya'i rgyal po la/ 'khor phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nyan rang gi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spos dang bcas pa'i rdor dril 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyangs shing*// smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i// khyed bzhaid 'gro don mdzad dus 'dir lags na// de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// yongs dag 'khor dang bcas rnams gshegs su gsol// oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥbha ga wān e h+ya hi ma hā kā ru ni ka dri sh+ya hoḥ sa ma yā s+t+waṃ/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ga ga na sa ma ye hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ dhu pe= ā lo ke= gan+dhe= nai wid+ya'i bar 'gres sbyar/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par bzhugs par mos/ mdo 'don pa'i dmigs pa ni/ gtso bo'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du yum chen mo la sras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis bskor ba/ yum chen mo'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su āḥ

de'i mthar shes rab kyi snying po'i mdo'i yig 'bru rnams gsal ba las rang sgra dang bcas 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal ba rnams la mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad bsdus nas rang dang bsrung bya rnams kyi gtsor byas sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib dag /nad gdon bar chad thams cad zhi nas stong nyid bco brgyad kyi don rgyud la skyes par gyur/ zhes pa'i spro bsdu dang*/ gtso 'khor kun gyis mgrin gcig tu gsung bar mos la/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab sogs nas/ mngon par bstod do'i bar ci 'grub 'don/ de nas mchod pa byin brlab gong bzhin byas la/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus pas bshams pa 'di// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad dang sngags gong 'og thams cad 'dra bar byas la/ me tog dang*/ puṣ+pe/ bdug spos dang*/ dhu pe/ snang gsal dang*/ a lo ke /dri chab dang*/ gan+dhe/ zhal zas dang*/ nai wid+ya/ rol mo dang*/ shap+da bcas brjod/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ni ta/ saṃ pra ra ni ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li ni/ pradz+nyā pa ra mi ta na da swā bhā we na/ badz+ra dharma hriḥd ya/ san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā/ dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya'i mthar se gol dang*/ oṃ bit+pāt+s+mu ra pū ra su ra su ra ā warta ya ā warta ya hoḥ rgyas par spro na/ bde bar gshegs pa sogs kyi rgyal srid/ kha dog dbyibs legs sogs kyis 'dod yon 'bul/ bsdu na/ mi dbang rin chen sna bdun 'di dag ni// sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa ma lus par// bshams shing yid kyis sprul te 'bul ba yis// 'gro ba mi bzad gter la spyod par shog

/oṃ sap+ta ma hā rat+na pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ phyogs dus kun nas gzugs sgra dri ro dang*// reg bya'i khyad par phun sum tshogs pa rnams// mos blos rgyal ba sras bcas la 'bul na// bzhes nas bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ pañca kā ma gu ṇa pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pa tsam brjod/ bstod pa'ang spro na sems rtse ma sogs bde gshegs spyi bstod kyang bya/ bsdu na/ thabs mkhas thugs rje shākya'i rigs su 'khrungs// gzhan gyis mi thub bdud kyi dpung 'joms pa// gser gyi lhun po lta bur brjid pa'i sku// shākya'i rgyal po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gang tshe rkang gnyis gtso bo khyod bltams tshe// sa chen 'di la gom pa bdun bor nas// nga ni 'jig rten 'di na mchog ces gsungs// de tshe mkhas pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin// ma skyes mi 'gags nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs bcu'i 'gro la mkhyen brtses rab dgongs nas// phyogs bcur chos kyi 'khor lo legs bskor te// phyogs bcu'i 'gro ba yongs su skyobs mdzad pa'i// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje spyan ras gzigs// sa yi snying po sgrib pa rnam par sel// nam mkha'i snying po byams pa kun tu bzang*// nye ba'i sras chen brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo// ston pa'i rtags 'chang nyan thos mchog /lhung bzed mkhar gsil pusti 'dzin// bslab sbyang yon tan kun ldan pa'i// nyan thos rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas bstod par bgyi// ces pas bstod/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// sogs nas/ thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o// zhes pa'i bar gyi yan lag bdun pa 'bul lo// mdun bskyed 'di la'ang 'dra min 'ga' zhig 'phel 'dug kyang 'khon gzhon nu sangs rgyas kyi gzhung du 'di bzhin 'byung ba rtsa ba'i yig cha yin par ma zad sher snying gleng gzhi dang yang mthun pas khungs che zhing*/

bdud zlog las tshogs lta bu yin cing 'di nyid mdo sgrub kyi dngos gzhi dang shin tu gal che bas thog mar bzlas sgom nan tan du byed pa gal che'o/ chos srung gtor 'bul spro na mdor bsdus tsam 'dir sbyar ro// gsum pa bdud zlog gi cho ga la sa bcad bcu gcig yod pa'i dang po byin gyis brlab pa ni/ mdun gyi yas gzugs la chab kyis bran la/ bdag nyid bcom ldan shākya thub// phyag rgya'i yi ge a dkar las// 'od 'phros gtor rdzas dngos 'dzin gyi// dri ma sbyangs nas stong par gyur// thal mo khong stong sbyar la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ lan gsum bzla bzhin phyag rgya bkrol nas se gol gtogs pa phyi ma rnams la'ang 'gre/ chos dbyings rnam dag phyag rgya sngags// ting 'dzin bden pas gtor rdzas kyi// 'bag rtsog nyams grib nyes skyon dang*// mtshan 'dzin dri ma dag gyur cig /bdag nyid bcom ldan rnam snang mdzad// phyag rgya'i yi ge kham̐ sngon las// 'od 'phros gtor rdzas zag med mdzod// nam mkha'i khams kun khyab par gyur// thal mo sbubs stong gi sbyar ba'i tshig bar pa rnams bcag pa rin chen sgrom bu'i phyag rgya smin mtshams su bskor zhing*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya sngags// ting 'dzin bden pas gtor rdzas rnams// bskal pa'i bar du zad mi shes// rgya chen nam mkha' gang gyur cig /bdag nyid bcom ldan bdud rtsi 'khyil// phyag rgya'i yi ge hrīḥdamar las// 'od 'phros gtor rdzas ye shes kyi// bdud rtsi chen po'i rang bzhin gyur// mthe bong bsnol/ sor mo gzhan rnams gshog pa ltar gdengs pa kha'i thad du bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdud rtsi thabs sbyor phyag rgya sngags// ting 'dzin bden pas gtor rdzas rnams// bdud rtsi ye shes lnga yi dngos// 'chi gsos dug lnga'i sman gyur cig

/bdag nyid bcom ldan rin chen 'byung*// phyag rgya'i yi ge trām̐ ser las// 'od 'phros gtor rdzas 'dod yon lnga*// so so'i mos pa ji bzhin gyur// lag gnyis mdzub mo bsgrengs pa'i khu tshur g.yon snying gar bzhag la/ g.yas brkyang ste g.yon gtod pa'i tshul byas la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ rgya chen shugs ldan phyag rgya sngags// ting 'dzin bden pas gtor rdzas rnams// dbang po'i spyod yul tshim byed pa'i// 'dod yon sna tshogs char 'baibs shog /bdag nyid bcom ldan don yod grub// phyag rgya'i yi ge ha ljang las// 'od 'phros mchog dman skal pa bzhin// 'thab rtsod med par thob par gyur// lag g.yas rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bcas/ g.yon pas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas snod 'degs pa'i tshul byas la/ oṃ dz+nyā na a ba lo ki te sa man+ta s+pha ra ṇa rasmi bha ba sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hri da ya dz+wa la ni hūm̐/ ye shes skar mda'i phyag rgya sngags// ting 'dzin bden pas mgron rnams kun// pham rgyal 'khrug rtsod med par thob// dgyes shing re ba skong gyur cig /bdag nyid bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin// phyag rgya'i yi ge dza dmar las// 'od 'phros mgron rnams dbang du sdus// phrin las gang 'dod sgrub par gyur// lag gnyis sor mo nang du bsnol ba'i khu tshur ngos mthe bong gnyis gshibs te brkyang pa spyi bor bskor te/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhaḥnāṃ gra he shwa ri pra bhañca dza ti ma hā sa ma ya swā hā/ dbang bsgyur 'khor lo'i phyag rgya sngags// ting 'dzin bden pas mgron rigs kun// bdag gi dbang 'dus gang bcol las// sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzad gyur cig /mthar/ na mo/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dag dang*// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// lan chags mgron rnams brngan pa dang*// sems can 'dod pas tshim pa dang*// don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun// de dag thams cad ci rigs pa// thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig

/ces bden pa'i stobs kyis kyang byin gyis brlab bo// gnyis pa bskyed cing spyan 'dren pa ni/ rang nyid thub dbang shākya'i rgyal por gsal// mdun bskyed rgyal ba sras bcas mtha' bskor gyi// shar du lha bdud dkar po me tog g.yas// lho ru nyon bdud ser po ral gri g.yas// nub tu phung bdud dmar po mdung dar g.yas// byang du 'chi bdud nag po khram shing g.yas// kun kyang lag g.yon zhags thogs bdun bdun re// rang mdog rta la zhon nas gus pas 'khod// khal dang khyi sogs rang rang grangs mnyam la// so so'i ci 'dod yon tan char du 'bebs// gnod byed bgegs rigs kun gyis bskor bar gsal// bdag gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis mdun bskyed bskul// de las khro chung dpag med 'phros pa yis// bgegs rigs lan chags mgron rnams bkug par gyur/ hūm̐/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing*// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha// bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal lo// dkon mchog bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// bar snang khams kyang 'gugs byed na// lus can rnams la smos ci dgos// sems med pa yang 'gugs byed na// lus sems ldan la smos ci dgos// 'dir ni gnod byed dgug tu gsol/ na mo/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags dang gzugs sngags rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthus bdud bzhi bdud kyi dmag tshogs rnams skad cig gis gzugs brnyan 'dir mchis par gyur cig /ṭā ki hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes bden stobs lan gsum brjod la/ kyai/ lha'i bu bdud ni dkar po ste// sems can chos spong las byed pa// ci yang med pa'i gnas su ni// lha bdud dpung dang sprul par bcas// gdan bshams rang gzugs dam pa 'dir// sngags 'chang bdag gis spyan 'dren na// thang cig yud tsam 'dir gshegs la// rang gzugs 'di la bzhugs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥganyis med thim/

kyai/ nyon mongs bdud ni ser po ste// sems can nyon mongs 'khor bar 'khyams// yod min med min gnas su ni// nyon mongs bdud kyi dmag tshogs rnams// sems can nyon mongs bsal ba'i phyir// sngags 'chang bdag gis spyan 'dren na// thang cig yud tsam 'dir gshegs la// rang gzugs 'di la bzhugs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥganyis med thim/ kyai/ phung po'i bdud ni dmar po ste// sems can 'dus pa bzhi las byung*// lus dang grib ltar lhan cig skyes// rnam shes mtha' yas gnas nas ni// phung po'i bdud kyi dmag tshogs rnams// sngags 'chang bdag gis spyan 'dren na// thang cig yud tsam 'dir gshegs la// rang gzugs 'di la bzhugs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥganyis med thim/ kyai/ 'chi bdag bdud ni nag po ste// sems can 'chi ba'i las byed pa// nam mkha' mtha' yas gnas su ni// 'chi bdag nag po'i bdud kyi tshogs// dpung dang g.yog 'khor bcas pa rnams// sngags 'chang bdag gis spyan 'dren na// thang cig yud tsam 'dir gshegs la// rang gzugs 'di la bzhugs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥganyis med thim// gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ bdud bzhi bdud kyi dmag tshogs rnams// yon bdag bdud bzhi bsal ba'i phyir// mchod bstod bgyid slad de srid bzhugs// de ring yon bdag 'di dag gis// mchod pa dam pa 'di bzhes la// bdud bzhi g.yos pa bsgyur du gsol// bzhi pa bdud zlog dngos ni/ spyir gzhung gi dgongs pa ltar na dge slong bzhi sde 'tshogs pa'i tshe/ slob dpon gyis 'bru gsum dang sam+bha ras bsngos pa'i tshe/ dge slong gzhan gsum gyis sher snying dang zlog pa tshar gsum re bton pas dgu zlog tu 'gro/ mthar 'dod gsol slob dpaun gyis bya ba yin kyang*/ da lta'i lag len ltar na dpon slob mang nyung du yod kyang 'don bya thams cad mnyam du byed pa yin pas/ thog mar shar gyi gral 'go nas bdud rkya mi gcig

/khal/ khyi/ chang bu/ thebs kyu/ sha dum/ zan chad bcas theb nang du bshams/ 'bru sna btab/ chu gtsang gis bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ gtor glud 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byams klas la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang yongs su bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo// na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ sngags lan bdun nam gsum/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ zhes pa nas bzung ste/ mngon par bstod do// zhes pa'i bar shes rab snying po tshar gsum dang snying po ci rigs bzlas la/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid lha'i bu'i bdud kyi dmag tshogs rnams la 'bul lo// rang rang so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i longs spyod zad mi shes pa 'byung bar gyur cig /thams cad mnyes shing tshim nas bdud bzhi'i gnod pa thams cad bsgyur du gsol/ ces rol mo dang bcas te theb nang du bshams pa'i glud yas rnams mar gzhi nag po'i steng du kha phyir bsgyur te bzhag /thal mo sbyar te/ na mo/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ sangs rgyas la= chos la= dge 'dun la= yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ ji ltar sngon lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don zab mo yid la bsams shing tshig kha 'don du byas pa'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas bdud sdig can la sogs pa phyir zlog pa de bzhin du/ sogs thal rdeb dkyus bzhin bya/ thabs dang skyobs dang dag pa dang*// theg chen nges par 'byung ba la// sems can rnams ni rab bslu bas// bdud kyi las rnams zlog tu gsol// zhes sbyar/ des tshar gcig song*/

des 'gres te shar phyogs kyi glud yas bdun ma rdzogs kyi bar du re re bshams la/ byin brlab nas zlog pa'i bar bshad ma thag pa ltar cha tshang ba re re bya/ glud yas rnams kyang phyogs so sor gral thabs su bsgrig go /dmigs bsal gyi zlog pa'i kha bsgyur ni/ yan chad 'brel/ bdag gis kyang yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i don zab mo yid la bsam zhing tshig kha bton du byas pa la brten nas/ nad pa yin na ming nas brjod la ming 'di zhes bya ba'i/ dang po nad kyi sna 'dren pa/ bar du nad kyi tshang bca' ba/ tha ma nad la mi phan par byed pa'i gdon bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad shes rab snying po'i bdud zlog bgyis pa 'di dang*/ 'phags pa dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' yi bden pas da lta nyid du phyir zlog par gyur cig /zhi bar gyur cig /rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /ces dang*/ sems can nad pa ji snyed pa// myur du nad las thar bar shog /'gro ba'i nad rnams ma lus pa// rtag tu 'byung ba med par shog /ces brjod/ than ltas la/ mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/ nyin gyi ltas ngan pa/ mtshan gyi rmi lam ngan pa/ khyad par du than ltas 'di zhes bya ba 'phags pa dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' yi bden pas da lta nyid du phyir zlog par gyur cig /zhi bar gyur cig /rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /ces dang*/ smon lam/ dus min 'chi bar gyur pa sna tshogs dang*// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan pa dang*// 'jigs pa brgyad sogs nye bar 'tshe ba rnams// myur du zhi zhing med par mdzad du gsol// ces brjod/ byad kha zlog na/ mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/ byad kha phur kha thun zor mnan gtad sbyor ngan phung sel bsdeb gshor rlung 'khor la sogs pa phas rgol byad ma'i rig sngags rbod gtong gi sbyor ba thams cad 'phags pa dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' yi bden pas da lta nyid du phyir zlog par gyur cig

/zhi bar gyur cig /rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /ces dang*/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa la// phyi dang nang du 'tshe ba yi// bar du gcod pa thams cad kun// nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol// ces brjod/ bstan dgra sogs la mthu byed na/ nus pa la brten nas/ bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' yi bden pas da lta nyid du khug cig /sgrol cig /sha khrag snang srid lha 'dres zo zhig /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su drongs shig /dkon mchog bden pas dmod pa yis// dgra bgegs byad ma thams cad kyi// lus ngag thal ba'i rdul bzhin rlog /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su spor// ces brjod do// de dag gis mtshon te/ nad yams/ lo nyes/ dmag 'khrugs/ rmi lam ngan pa/ gdon chen/ mi kha/ gyod dang god kha sogs gang la'ang zlog pa dang smon lam gyi kha bsgyur rigs pas 'phrul shes par bya'o// phyogs gzhan rnams la'ang des 'gres te/ lhor nyon mongs pa'i bdud/ nub tu phung po'i bdud/ byang du 'chi bdag gi bdud kyi dmag tshogs zhes tshig bsngo kha bsgyur ba tsam las gzhan shar phyogs dang 'dra bar phyogs re nas bdun re ma rdzogs par btud/ mdo 'don pa'i tshe/ dbang po rab kyis chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med pa/ spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba brjod du med pa'i rang bzhin gyi ngo bor bsam la/ de'i ngang nas ma g.yos bzhin du mdo 'don par bya'o// dbang po 'bring gis brjod pa dang bral ba'i don de yang sngon du dran par byas la/ mdo zlog pa'i bya ba thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang nas bya'o// dbang po tha mas kyang sngon du brjod bral dang rmi lam sgyu ma dran par byas la/ tshig tu 'don pa'i sgra la sems gtad de ma yengs par byas la mthong thos la sogs pa thams cad shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ngo bo nyid snyam du shes par byas te mdo 'don par gsungs so// lnga pa gtor ma bsngo ba ni/

shar gyi lha bshos chab kyis bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ sam+bha ra'i sngags lan bdun gyis bsngo/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod cing phyag 'tshal ba'i mthar/ zhal zas ro brgya nus pa stong dang ldan pa 'di nyid lha'i bu'i bdud kyi dmag tshogs rnams la 'bul lo// rang rang so so'i bsam dang mthun pa'i longs spyod zad mi shes pa 'byung bar gyur cig /thams cad mnyes shing tshims nas bdud bzhi g.yos pa'i gnod pa thams cad bsgyur du gsol/ zhes brjod cing 'og gzhi'i lha'i bu'i bdud rnams kyi mdun du zhal zas 'bul/ thams cad nam mkha' mdzod bzhin du// longs spyod zad pa med pa dang*// rtsod pa med cing 'tshe med par// rang dbang du ni spyod par shog /bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// bdud bzhi rnams la mchod pa dang*// sems can rnams la phan gdags slad// don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun// de dag thams cad ci rigs pa// thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /ces bden stobs kyis bsngo'o// de bzhin du lho'i gtor ma me tog dbyibs can bran la 'bru gsum gyis byin brlab dang*/ sam+bha ra'i sngags lan bdun/ mtshan bzhi brjod la/ gtor ma me tog dbyibs can ro brgya nus pa stong dang ldan pa 'di nyid nyon mongs pa'i bdud kyi dmag tshogs rnams la 'bul lo// rang rang so so'i nas bden stobs brjod pa yan gong ltar byas la gtor ma nyon bdud kyi mdun du phul/ nub kyi dkar gtor bran la byin brlab sogs gong ltar byas la/ dkar gtor ro brgya nus pa stong dang ldan pa 'di nyid phung po'i bdud kyi dmag tshogs rnams la 'bul lo// rang rang so so'i sogs gong ltar la gtor ma phung po'i bdud rnams kyi mdun du phul/ byang gi dmar gtor bran la byin brlab sogs dang*/

dmar gtor ro brgya nus pa stong dang ldan pa 'di nyid 'chi bdag gi bdud kyi dmag tshogs rnams la 'bul lo// rang rang so so'i sogs gong ltar la gtor ma 'chi bdud kyi mdun du 'bul lo// drug pa glud bsngo ni/ ngar mi'i steng du nad pa sogs khrus byas pa'i chu blug la chab kyis bran/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis byin gyis brlabs la/ sam+bha ra'i sngags bdun dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod mthar/ hūm̐/ ngar mi pho mo mdzes pa 'di// de ring yon gyi bdag po'i glud// rgyu ni rin chen lnga las grub// dar tshon rnams kyi chas kyis brgyan// rgyan cha de ni lhubs se lhub// kha ru de ni g.yu yang bcug /lag tu de ni gser bskur ro// bdud bzhi rnams kyi phyag tu 'bul// la 'phrad de ni la ru zlog /lung 'phrad de ni lung du zlog /smra mkhas de ni sa la la// 'gro mkhas de ni ldems se ldem// mgo la thod bcings bkrag re che// lus bzang de ni rgyan gyis brgyan// ming bzang de ni stobs che la// bzung ba'i yul ni ma mchis so// yon gyi bdag po bslu ba'i phyir// de ring bdag gis 'di btang bas// glud bdag chen pos glud bzhes shig /rnam shes tshogs brgyad 'byung ba lnga// rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i glud// khams dang skye mched rnams kyi glud// dbang po tshogs drug rnams kyi glud// 'bru mchog ngar gyi mi bo che// rin chen sna lnga'i na bza' can// 'khor ba'i g.yul zlog dar mdung g.yas// g.yon na thar dgu lams se lam// rkang pa g.yas pa thabs chen lcags// rkang pa g.yon pa shes rab zangs// de 'dra'i 'bru mchog mi bo che// bdud bzhi dmag tshogs 'khor bcas la// yon bdag 'di yi glud du 'bul// mi bas glud kyi bzang bas na// bdud bzhi dmag tshogs thams cad kyis// glud bzang mdzes pa 'di khyer la// da ni rang rang gnas su song*// dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' ma bcag

/lha dbang brgya byin gyis bskul bas// bcom ldan shākya thub pa yis// bdud bzhi bkug nas yas glud byin// bka' bsgos dam bzhag mdzad pa yi// dam tshig de nyid dran gyis la// 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig /bdud rnams rang rang gnas su song*// bdud kha glud kyis chos par gyis// bdud bzhi g.yos pa zhi gyur cig /thams cad nam mkha' mdzod bzhin du// longs spyod zad pa med pa dang*// rtsod pa med cing 'tshe med par// rang dbang du ni spyod par shog /bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// bdud bzhi rnams la mchod pa dang*// sems can rnams la phan gdags slad// don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun// de dag thams cad ci rigs pa// thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /ces bsngos la ngar mi bdud bzhi'i dbus su stegs bu'i steng du kha phyir bsgyur la bzhag /skabs 'dir nad pa yod na nad spo ba'i phyag len yod par bshad do// bdun pa bka' bsgo ba ni/ hūm̐/ nga ni bcom ldan shākya thub// nga ni dpal chen gsang ba'i bdag /nga ni sngags 'chang sgrub pa po// nga ni bdud bgegs gnyen po ste// bdud chen dang ni lha dang klu// 'byung po yi dwags sha za dang*// nad bdag ma mo la sogs pa// nga yi bka' las ma 'da' zhig /ngar glud gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi /nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod// bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol// bsdams pa glod la mnan pa khyog /bcol ba'i phrin las ma bsgrub na// sngon gyi bde gshegs chad pa yis// sems can dmyal ba rnams su yang*// yang nas yang du skye 'gyur zhing*// shin tu ya nga'i sdug bsngal myong*// de bas gnod pa ma byed par// bdud bzhi rang rang gnas su song*// bden cing bslu med sangs rgyas bka'// de bzhin sgrubs dang bde ba 'thob// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag rnams// bdud chen bzhi las thar ba dang*// bar chad nad gdon myur zhi nas// bsam pa'i don rnams 'grub par mdzod// brgyad pa rdzongs 'debs dang gshegs gsol ni/

'bru sna tshogs btab la/ kyai/ bdud kyi dmag tshogs khyed rnams kyis// ji ltar bsgos bzhin byas nas ni// skye mched mu bzhi'i gnas su dengs// lha'i bu'i bdud ni dkar po khyod// ci yang med pa'i gnas su dengs// nyon mongs bdud ni ser po khyod// rnam shes mtha' yas gnas su dengs// phung po'i bdud ni dmar po khyod// yod min med min gnas su dengs// 'chi bdag bdud ni nag po'i tshogs// nam mkha' mtha' yas gnas su dengs// shes sgrib nyon mongs las byung ba'i// lha yi bdud dang nyon mongs bdud// phung po'i bdud dang 'chi bdag bdud// bdud bzhi'i bdud kyi dmag tshogs rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'di dag la// bzung ba thongs la mnan pa khyog /bdud chen mi la ma 'bebs shig /skye mched mu bzhi'i gnas su dengs// rang rang mdzes pa'i pho brang du// bde ba'i sems dang ldan par mdzod// 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig /rang rang gnas su bde bar gshegs// sa ma ya pra be sha ya phaṭa/ ces brjod la/ bdud bzhi 'khor bcas byams pa dang mgu ba'i sems kyis rang gnas su song bar bsam la/ phul phyogs su phyir cung zad khyer du bcol nas kha phyir bstan la bzhag /phul phyogs ni nad pa'i don du byed na dur chen thog tu phul// de bzhin spar kha'i bcos yin na bzhi gshed bdun zur dgra thog gang gnod phyogs su phul/ bde rim yin na lam mdo'am yas lam gang bder phul/ mthu zlog byed na byad ma'i phyogs su phul/ mthu byed na dgra thog tu/ rgyal pos gnod na lha khang ngam mchod rten rtsar/ 'dre mos gnod na grong mdo'am lung gsum mdor/ char 'bod pa'am klus gnod na mtsho'am chu mig tu phul/ yul lhas gnod na de phyogs su/ mdor na gang dang gang gnod der bskyal bar gsungs so// dgu pa gser skyems ni/ dkar gtor gser skyems 'bru sna blugs pa bshams la chab kyis bran te/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan shākya'i rgyal po dang*// dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' byung gis// sngags 'chang bdag gi ngag la nyon// steng 'og phyogs bcur gnas pa yi// snang srid lha srin sde brgyad sogs// gzhi bdag yul grong gnyug mar bcas// sa bdag klu gnyan 'khor 'bangs bcas// 'dod yon mchod sbyin gtor ma dang*// rin chain gser skyems 'di bzhes la// phrag dog ko long ma bsdom par// sgo ba rnams kyis sgo phyes shig /'phrang ba rnams kyis 'phrang sol cig /khyed rnams g.yas dang g.yon du gzur// de ring gtor lam gnyan po phyes// de ring yas kyi lam phyes shig /rnal 'byor bdag gi mthu dpung mdzod// gtor lam phyes la dmag sna drongs// ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad cig /bdag gi dpung dang grogs mdzod cig /dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma zlog /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// ces gser skyems mchod cing dkar gtor mdos phul phyogs su bskyal lo// bcu pa zlog bsgyur ni/ yas glud rnams khyer mi'i lag tu bzung bcol nas/ bdud dang ma mo rnams kyi gdug pa zlog bsgyur bya ba ni/ gdug pa ston pa 'khor bcas kyi thugs rjes zlog par bsams la/ bh+yo/ ma cig yams bdag 'khor dang bcas// khyod kyi lag pa g.yas pa na// bdud kyi khram bam re re yod// bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas rnams// gal te khram la btab srid na// khram kha phyes shig ma cig ma// khyod kyi lag pa g.yon pa na// btsan gyi shwa rdel dkar nag bkram// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag rnams// gal te rtsis la bcug pa na// shwa rde'u dkar nag da phyes shig /khyod kyi mchan khung g.yas pa na// gshin rje'i khram shing dmar po yod// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag rnams// gal te khram la btab pa na// byang dmar dkyus nas da phyungs shig

/khyod kyi mchan khung g.yon pa na// nad kyi rkyal pa nag po la// sbrul nag lnga brgya'i kha chings can// sprul pa mang po de nas 'gyed// sprul pa'i dmag dpung da phyungs shig /yon bdag bslu phyir bdud zlog 'bul// 'bul ba bdag gis ma nor la// len pa khyed kyis ma nor zhig /bzhes shig kun gyis dgyes par rol// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi /ban bon byad kha da zlog cig /klu gnyan gtad khram da zlog cig /dgra jag chom rkun da zlog cig /mi kha ngan pa da zlog cig /nor phyugs god kha da zlog cig /mi yi shi 'phro da chod cig /yams nad rims nad da zlog cig /ma nyes kha yog da zlog cig /mi mthun gnod pa'i tshogs rnams kun// shes rab snying po'i yas zlog 'dis// da lta nyid du zlog bsgyur cig /shes rab zlog bcas byin rlabs kyis// sa chu me rlung skag ngan zlog /ngar glud yas sogs gzugs 'gros kyis// ltas ngan rang sar zhi bar mdzod// nad yams god kha bzlog tu gsol// de bzhin gang la gang 'tshe ba// dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje dang*// shes rab snying po'i byin rlabs dang*// sngags 'chang bdag gi nus mthu yis// bdud bzhi'i gnod pa ma lus kun// da lta rang rang gnas su zlog /sa ma ya pra bā+e sha ya phaṭa/ drag tu brjod cing rol mo byas la phyi rol tu bskyal bcol/ de'i tshe rgyas pa shes rab snying po tshar gsum dang dgra zlog bya/ bsdu na mdo tshar gcig dang zlog pa lan gsum bya/ shin tu bsdu na ga te lan gsum brjod pa'i mthar zlog pa re bya ba de 'dra lan gsum/ spyi dang bye brag dmigs bsal gang yin pa'i bden stobs brjod mthar thal rdeb bcas kyi tshigs su bcad pa rnams kyang sngar bzhin bya/ de'i tshe rang gi lag gnyis nyi zlar gsal ba dang*/ sangs rgyas dang nyan thos rnams kyis chos gos byang sems rnams kyis thal mo brdab/ chos skyong sprul pa'i dmag dpung dang bcas pas mtshon cha'i char phabs pas gnod byed gang yin rdul du brlags par bsam/

mthu byed pa'am gal che dus ri la phul bar 'gro na/ gong gi ma mo'i zlog pa'i mgo nas phyir khyer la der phyin pa dang*/ gser skyems gtor la ma mo'i zlog pa man chad dang*/ shes rab snying po'i zlog pa lan gsum gyis bar 'di der 'don la 'bul lo/ gang ltar yang zlog pa grub 'phral rang dang bsrung bya mi nor 'khor bcas bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag g.yas sa gnon gyi 'og tu tshud par bsams la/ ga te bzla ba'am/ cung zad spro na/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rāt+s+mum̐ yig ser po ni// yongs gyur gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong pa// yangs shing rgya che phyi rol gnam sa khyab// de rgyab bdag mdun thugs las 'od 'phros pas// sher phyin glegs bam ral gri rdo rje yi// gur khang rim gsum ye shes me dpung 'bar// bskal pa'i rlung yang thar ba med pa'i nang*// bsrung bya thams cad thub pa'i sku ru gyur// rtsibs nang sangs rgyas stong dang gur khang gi /bar rnams sangs rgyas bye ba dpag med bzhugs// de dag kun dang mdun bskyed 'khor bcas kyis// skyabs sbyin phyag rgyas bdag 'khor bsrung bar gyur// ces bsgom la/ tad+ya thā/ ga te ga te pā ra ga te pā ra saṃ ga te bho dhi bdag dang bsrung bya thams cad srungs shig rak+ṣa ku ru swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzlas so// mthar gzung 'dzin gyi chos thams cad mi dmigs pa stong nyid kyi lta ba'i klong du ci gnas su bzhag go /bcu gcig pa shis brjod bya ba ni/ nad pa gal chen yod na gos dkar po gyon la stan dkar po'i steng du kha shar du bltas la 'dug /rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyis me tog 'thor zhing shis brjod mdzad par mos la/ rol mo bsgrag cing 'bru 'thor la/ hūm̐/ dbus kyi phyogs nas bkra shis pa// rnam par snang mdzad bkra shis lags// sku lus bzang po'i bkra shis gang yin pa// dza ye de ring sbyin bdag 'di la stsol// bkra shis des kyang khyod la bde legs shog

/hūm̐/ shar gyi phyogs nas bkra shis pa// rdo rje sems dpa'i bkra shis lags// mi 'gyur brtan pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa// dza ye de ring sbyin bdag 'di la stsol// bkra shis des kyang khyod la bde legs shog /hūm̐/ lho yi phyogs nas bkra shis pa// rin chen 'byung gnas bkra shis lags// 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i bkra shis gang yin pa// dza ye de ring sbyin bdag 'di la stsol// bkra shis des kyang khyod la bde legs shog /hūm̐/ nub kyi phyogs nas bkra shis pa// snang ba mtha' yas bkra shis lags// dbang sdud snyan grags bkra shis gang yin pa// dza ye de ring sbyin bdag 'di la stsol// bkra shis des kyang khyod la bde legs shog /hūm̐/ byang gi phyogs nas bkra shis pa// don yod grub pa bkra shis lags// phrin las lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis de// dza ye de ring sbyin bdag 'di la stsol// bkra shis des kyang khyod la bde legs shog /hūm̐/ 'og gi phyogs nas bkra shis pa// sa yi lha mo brtan ma'i bkra shis lags// tshe 'dzin 'bru sna'i bkra shis gang yin pa// dza ye de ring sbyin bdag 'di la stsol// bkra shis des kyang khyod la bde legs shog /nyin yang bkra shis 'byung ba ya la la// mtshan yang bkra shis 'byung ba kyi li li// bkra shis dus gsum 'byung ba gang yin pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /ces pa dang*/ gzhan yang bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa brjod do/ rtsa ba'i gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga ni/ mdun gyi mchod pa rnams kha gsos/ gong ltar byin gyis brlabs/ spro na tshigs bcad brjod/ bsdu na/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du sngags gong 'og thams cad 'dra bar byas la/ pād+yaṃ nas/ shap+da'i bar gyis mchod/ thabs mkhas thugs rje shākya'i rigs su 'khrungs// sogs sh+lo ka dang*/

bstod par 'os pa sogs sh+lo kas bstod la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol/ yig brgya lan gsum/ thal mo sbyar la/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol// gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas// legs spyad 'di la nyes gyur pa// gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir// de kun mgon khyod bzod par mdzod// ces bzod par gsol/ mdun bskyed kyi 'khor rnams 'od du zhu nas gtso bo la thim par gyur// rten med na gshegs gsol bya/ skabs 'dir thub sku bzhugs pa'i dbang du byas te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ khyad par du yang sku gzugs kyi rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu// 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang*// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol// ces dang*/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha'i sngags brjod la brtan bzhugs bya/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /de bzhin gshegs pa khyed sku ci 'dra ba// sogs kyis bsngo smon bya/

de nas dril gsil 'thor nas bcas/ ston mchog dam pa lha mi'i mchod 'os pa// sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /zhi ba chags bral lha mi'i mchod 'os pa// chos la phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /tshogs kyi dam pa lha mi'i mchod 'os pa// dge 'dun phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /ces sogs mchog gsum bkra shis sh+lo ka gsum sogs sngon du 'gro bas shis brjod gang rung dang*/ mthar/ nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyin mo'i gung yang bde legs shing*// nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa// dkon mchog gsum gyis deng 'dir stsol// deng 'dir rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad nyi ma dang zla ba gza' sgra gcan gyi kha nas thar ba bzhin du 'gal rkyen spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig /ces brjod rol mo rgya cher bya'o// de ltar byas pa'i phan yon ni bsam gyis mi khyab cing brjod du mi longs par 'byung bar gsungs la/ khyad par du ban bon gyi rbod gtong byad las gnod pa/ gtad la bcug pa/ na tsha rgod pa'i 'phro gcod pa/ yul du nad yams rims nad dar ba/ phyugs nad god kha mang ba/ khyim du rgyal po la sogs pa'i gdon zhugs pa rnams dang*/ skar ma ngan par shi ba/ ma nyes pa'i kha g.yog 'ong ba/ mi kha che ba/ sri'u ma sos pa/ nor la dkar 'gong 'ong ba/ than dang rmi lam ltas ngan pa/ lo dang spar kha rtsub pa/ mthu ltas byung ba sogs la 'di'i zlog pa byas pas de ma thag tu zlog par 'gyur ro// tshe tshad mthar phyin pa ma gtogs bar chad kyis zin pa la gnod tshab che chung dang bstun pa'i lan gcig

/gsum/ lnga/ bdun/ dgu sogs bskyar na nges par sel ba the tshom med do zhes gong ma rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu bsngags so// de ltar yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yum rgyas 'bring bsdus pa rnams la phan yon bsngags pa ji snyed gsungs pa rnams tshul 'di la'ang 'byung bar rigs pas gto zlog thams cad las khyad par du 'phags pa dang rig pa myong bas grub pa yin no// de ltar rgya gar mkhas grub rnams kyi thugs bcud/ dpal ldan a ti sha'i yi dam/ dge bshes pu to ba rin chen/ ring mo 'byung gnas rdo rje/ gyi ljang dbu dkar ba sogs kyi phyag len 'khrul med 'di la snga phyir byon pa'i yig cha 'dra min mang du mchis pa las/ rtsa ba'i gzhung dang 'brel nges pa'i yig cha rnams kyis bcud blangs nas dag gtsang bklag chog tu bkod pa'o// don dam dbang du gegs bas sangs rgyas kyang*// med ces dpal gyi mgul nas legs par gsungs// kun rdzob 'khrul ngor rgyu 'bras mi bslu bas// rten cing 'brel 'byung tshul 'dir yid ches 'tshal// sher phyin mdo las dngos su bstan pa'i don// 'phral yun bar chad zlog la ches zab pa// 'di bkod dge bas bdud bgegs nag po'i phyogs// zhi zhing phan bde yar ngo rab rgyas shog /'di nyid kun la nyer mkho gyur kyang phyogs 'dir yig cha gsal ba ma mchis shing mi bskyod zhabs kyis mdzad par grags pa de'ang rje de nyid kyi gsung yin nges mi snang ba ma zad mgo gzhug ma tshang bas rang gzhan kun la phan 'dod bsam pas yon tan rgya mtsho blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes dpal spungs yang khrod kyi sgrub gnas su bris pa dge legs 'phel/// /
